Metadata.title: AirManager
Metadata.description: Airfield management: pilots, aircraft, flights, bookings and finances in one place.

HomePage.title: AirManager
HomePage.description: Pilots, aircraft, flights, PPR requests, finances, flight school and expiries: airfield operations in one reliable system.

LoginPage.title: Sign in to AirManager
LoginPage.description: Enter your email and password to access your account.

DashboardPage.subtitle: Operational areas (pilots, aircraft, flights, bookings...) arrive in upcoming iterations.

UsersPage.title: Users
UsersPage.description: Create users, assign roles and manage access to the system.

SetPasswordPage.title: Set your password
SetPasswordPage.description: Choose a password of at least 10 characters to sign in to AirManager.
SetPasswordPage.success: Password set. You can now sign in.
SetPasswordPage.errorTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters long.
SetPasswordPage.errorGeneric: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

ForgotPasswordPage.title: Recover your password
ForgotPasswordPage.description: Enter your email: if the account exists, we'll send you a link to reset your password.
ForgotPasswordPage.confirmation: If that email address matches an active account, you'll receive an email shortly with instructions to reset your password.

invite.subject: You've been invited to AirManager
invite.body:
Hello,

You've been invited to access AirManager. Set your password within {expiresInDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} by visiting the link below:

{url}

If you weren't expecting this invite, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your AirManager password
passwordReset.body:
Hello,

You requested to reset your AirManager account password. The link below is valid for {expiresInHours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}:

{url}

If you didn't request this, ignore this email: your current password remains unchanged.
